RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the May 6, 2008/Vaisakha 16, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
178
Special tourism status to Uttar
Pradesh and Uttarakhand
*561. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased
to state:
(a) the States which have been accorded
special tourism status;
(b) the funds allocated by Government
to each of such States during the last three
years, year-wise;
(c) whether there is any proposal to
accord special tourism status to Uttar
Pradesh and Uttarakhand;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) by when the decision is likely to be
taken in this regard?
Supply of gas through pipelines in the
country
*562. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
supply cooking gas to consumers through
pipelines in the country, particularly in
Jyotiba Phule Nagar and Moradabad in
Uttar Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) the details of funds sanctioned/spent
so far and the time schedule fixed for the
completion of the scheme;
(d) the expected number of consumers
to be benefited under this scheme;
(e) whether gas cylinders are likely to
be taken from the consumers covered under
the scheme; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Requirement of chartered
accountants
†*563. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of CORPORATE AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of chartered
accountants required in the country at
present;
(b) the total number of educational
institutions which provide education in the
discipline of chartered accountancy in the
country at present and the total number of
seats in these institutions;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

179
(c) the action being taken by
Government to provide education for the
discipline of chartered accountancy as per
demand in the country; and
(d) if not, whether Government would
take action to ensure availability of chartered
accountants as per demand?
Upgradation of Jharsuguda Airstrip
*564. SHRI PYARIMOHAN
MOHAPATRA: W ill the Minister of
CIVIL A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) the progress of converting Jharsuguda
Airstrip into a regular airport; and
(b) the detailed action plan by the
Airports Authority of India (AAI),
projected investment and the expected date
of completion of the project?
Investment in R & D activities
*565. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) what is the investment both in
amount as well as in percentage in the
Research and Development (R&D)
activities of various Public Sector
Undertakings and institutes under the
Ministry;
(b) whether it is a fact that investment
in R&D is far below the level required for a
country aspiring to emerge as economic
super power;
(c) what are the general norms for
investment in R&D in various fields under
their control; and
(d) how this percentage of investment
is comparable with similar undertakings and
institutes of the developed countries?
Contractual workers in national
carriers
*566. SHRI PRABHAT: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government owned Indian
Airlines and Air India are hiring manpower
for their works on the contractual basis;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the departments where this
manpower has been utilized?
Loan waiver scheme for farmers
*567. SHRI PRAKASH JAV ADEKAR:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether instructions have been
issued by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
for the loan waiver scheme announced in
the annual budget;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has taken any
decision regarding inclusion of farmers in
the scheme, who hold more than 2 hectares
of land;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether Government has taken any
decision for inclusion of farmers in the
scheme who have taken loan from private
moneylenders; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?

180
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Closure of private company operated
petrol-pumps
†*568. SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of petrol-pumps set up
by private companies in the country, so
far;
(b) whether it is a fact that the petrol-
pumps run by the private companies are
being closed down due to incurring of losses;
(c) if so, the number of petrol-pumps
that have been closed down from 1st
February, 2008 till date alongwith the
details thereof, company-wise and State-
wise; and
(d) the steps taken by Government so
that consumers do not suffer?

Minister of PETROLEUM AND
